confidence_notes: Restaurant, coffee and beer anchors are based on several 2026 cost-of-living aggregators (Numbeo-style data via Expatica, Ocity, 360nations, Travelsafe) that broadly agree, with some spread. Cocktail anchors rest on Square's San Antonio bar-pricing averages, which are undated. No citable wine-by-the-glass average was found, so wine_glass is estimated from the local beer relationship (roughly 1.5x the beer anchor). Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and city context, not inspected live listings. FX: the only official RBA observation retrieved was the rba.gov.au exchange-rates page snapshot as at 20 March 2026 (AUD/USD 0.7088). I could not retrieve a newer official RBA observation, so this rate is stale relative to the 2026-11-19 generation date and should be refreshed from the RBA F11 table before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: Priced against mid-sized US Southwest cities with similar tourism demand and downtown hotel supply, using the San Antonio aggregated data above.
